title: Mannerheimintie → Töölö → Seurasaari
description: Drivable corridor from Esplanadi up Mannerheimintie through Töölö to Tullinpuomi, then Paciuksenkatu and Seurasaarentie to the Seurasaari bridge and island.

legs.label: Pohjoisesplanadi → Mannerheimintie → Töölö → Tullinpuomi → Paciuksenkatu → Seurasaarentie

limitations: Seurasaari island and its wooden bridge are car-free in reality. Driving there is a game liberty; real visitors park at the mainland end of the bridge.
Checkpoints are narrative anchors, not a verified navigation track. Confirm turn permissions before calling this a legal driving route.
Terrain remains flat, as in the harbour slice; Töölö slopes and the bridge deck rise are not modelled.
